commentaire: The prologue was stopped due to a thunderstorm with heavy rainfall. The jury decided to cancel the race with nine riders still left to go. The fastest rider at that moment was Steffen RADOCHLA, who will be considered the stage's winner. None of the results today will count toward the GC. Therefore, no CQ points were given in this stage.
titre: Österreich-Rundfahrt - Wiesbauer Tour, Prologue : Klausen I.T.T. (1,5 km)
